transport.approved_method: GET one full file once each, no redirects beyond https://zenodo.org
transport.response_rows_transferred: Full biological data file physically transferred into ephemeral RAM for checksum; cannot claim zero bytes opened.

interpretation.G: trap capture count or recorded occurrence, not certified occupancy without effort/detection audit
interpretation.B: host-plant spatial cover at stated spatial scale
interpretation.M: host-patch connectivity may depend on host geometry; a separate movement-only M must be justified
interpretation.A: forest-type habitat proxy, not abiotic tolerance
interpretation.join: site/trap and year identifiers, uniqueness and crosswalk unverified until subsequent row-qualification
interpretation.preexisting_associations: published author ecological effects are prior art
interpretation.claim: no new ecological response score from source/schema gate

fail_closed: 403/429/redirect/size/MD5/parse failure is a terminal STOP. No alternate host or undocumented file.
next: If complete verified schema then separately freeze outcome mapping, matched occurrence/effort and held-out comparator before first row-level ecological scoring
